result.topic_en: Outline notes on asymptotic counting results derived from Dirichlet series (numbers of the form 2^m 3^n, sums of two squares, numbers a^2 b^3) and Tauberian-type comparison theorems for steadily increasing sequences.
result.transcription:
5. Analogous results in case of
$\frac{a_1}{1^s} + \frac{a_2}{2^s} + \frac{a_3}{3^s} + \cdots\cdots$
(i) e.g. The no of nos of the form $2^m \cdot 3^n$ such as $1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9, 12, \ldots$
less than $x$ $= \frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{\log(2x)}{\log 2} \cdot \frac{\log(3x)}{\log 3} + O(1)$.
(ii) No.s of the form $a^2+b^2$ less than $x$
$= C\int \frac{dx}{\sqrt{\log x}} + O(x^{\frac{1}{2}+\varepsilon})$
where $C = \sqrt{2(1-\frac{1}{3^2})(1-\frac{1}{7^2})(1-\frac{1}{11^2})(1-\frac{1}{19^2})(1-\frac{1}{23^2})(1-\frac{1}{31^2})(1-\frac{1}{43^2})\cdots}$
$\sqrt{2(1-\frac{1}{3^2})(1-\frac{1}{7^2})(1-\frac{1}{11^2})(1-\frac{1}{19^2})} = (1+\frac{1}{7})(1+\frac{1}{11})(1+\frac{1}{19})$.
(iii) No of the form $a^2 b^3$ such as $1, 4, 8, 9, 16, 25, 27, 32, 36 \cdots\cdots$
less than $x$
$= \sqrt{4.7[-2-]{+3+}034x} - \sqrt[3]{3.10227x} + O(x^{\frac{1}{6}+\varepsilon})$.
6. If $a_n$ and $b_n$ are steadily increasing and if
$\frac{1}{a_1^s} + \frac{1}{a_2^s} + \frac{1}{a_3^s} + \cdots\cdots$
and $\frac{1}{b_1^s} + \frac{1}{b_2^s} + \frac{1}{b_3^s} + \cdots\cdots$
are both convergent when $s > k$ and both are divergent when
$s = k$ and if the difference between the two series be $O(1)$
when $s = k$, then
$a_n \sim b_n$.
e.g.
7. If $a_n$ and $b_n$ are steadily increasing and if
$e^{-a_1 x} + e^{-a_2 x} + e^{-a_3 x} + \cdots\cdots$
$\sim e^{-b_1 x} + e^{-b_2 x} + e^{-b_3 x} + \cdots\cdots$ as $x \to 0$
